newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares rebound as Salus jumps.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares rebound as Salus jumps.

text.p: Slovenian shares firmed 1.16 percent on Thursday on the back of a nine percent jump in drug wholesaler Salus, reversing a three-day losing streak, but traders remained sceptical on the market's outlook.

"I do not think that today's gains mark the beginning of a long-term uptrend. Salus went up mostly because many traders expect a good dividend to be paid this year," said Andrej Kavcic, a trader at brokerage Ilirika.
No one at Salus was available to comment on the firm's dividend outlook.
* The SBI index rose 15.27 points to 1,336.46.
* Overall 10 shares rose, five fell and one was flat, while 11 were untraded.
* Salus was the top gainer, jumping 9.25 percent to 16,770 tolars on volume of 730 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
